dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Um... So, I actually received an invitation to Miss Aino's engineering seminar.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: ...Did that happen because I drew everyone's attention when I skipped the last time with that ridiculous excuse?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: What should I do now...? Should I act like I never saw it? Maybe I can still put the letter back where it was...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Never mind. It feels wrong to just act like I didn't see it.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: But of course, it'd be a whole different story if I were to be called away on an urgent mission on that day. I should check the mailbox again...
